articles.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.

articles.title: XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why
articles.snippet: XRP remains below its 2017-cycle high while bitcoin, ether and other major tokens have surged, enriching their holders.

articles.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.

articles.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
articles.snippet: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
articles.snippet: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.
